title: Verify Resolved Errors in the Robotics SystemErrorActivityModel
summary: Use read-only SSMS access to the Robotics Database to verify that a resolved active error appears as archived activity in the SystemErrorActivityModel. Inspect the SystemErrorDescription, SystemErrorResolution, Start Time, Finish Time, and duration fields.
when_to_use: Use this read-only WCS / Helix DB (SSMS) diagnostic when an active error is reported as resolved and support must verify that the error was archived in the Robotics Database SystemErrorActivityModel with recorded timing and resolution details.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to infer resolution success solely from the presence of a SystemErrorResolution value.
Do not use this procedure as a recovery or error-clearing procedure; it only verifies archived error activity.

roles_and_responsibilities.responsibility: Use read-only SSMS access to inspect the Robotics Database SystemErrorActivityModel and determine whether the resolved error has complete archived timing and resolution details.
Review or support escalation when the expected archived record or timing fields are missing.

safety_notes: This is a read-only diagnostic; no production control or error-clearing action is specified.

access_required: L2 or L3 support access to WCS / Helix DB (SSMS).
system_preconditions: An active error is reported as resolved and can be identified by its error name or SystemErrorDescription.

visual_references.description: Robotics Database System Error view showing SystemErrorActivityModel archived records with SystemErrorDescription, SystemErrorResolution, Start Time, Finish Time, and duration values.

steps.title: Open the Robotics Database in SSMS
steps.purpose: Access the Robotics Database where the SystemErrorActivityModel archived-error records are stored.
steps.instruction: In WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), select the Robotics Database and open the database view used to inspect the SystemErrorActivityModel.
steps.expected_result: The Robotics Database is selected and the SystemErrorActivityModel is available for inspection.
steps.healthy_condition: SSMS is connected to the Robotics Database and the SystemErrorActivityModel can be opened.
steps.failure_condition: The Robotics Database or SystemErrorActivityModel is unavailable for inspection.

actions.label: Select Robotics Database
actions.exact_action: Open SSMS and select the Robotics Database.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the Robotics Database or SystemErrorActivityModel cannot be accessed.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: The Robotics Database view includes the SystemErrorActivityModel and displays archived system-error activity.

steps.title: Locate the archived error record
steps.purpose: Find the archived activity record corresponding to the error reported as resolved.
steps.instruction: In the Robotics Database SystemErrorActivityModel on WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), locate the record using the error name or SystemErrorDescription.
steps.expected_result: A SystemErrorActivityModel row corresponding to the reported error is located.
steps.healthy_condition: The matching archived row is identifiable by its error name or SystemErrorDescription.
steps.failure_condition: No corresponding archived SystemErrorActivityModel row can be located.

actions.label: Locate archived error
actions.exact_action: Open the SystemErrorActivityModel and locate the error record by its error name or SystemErrorDescription.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if an error reported as resolved has no corresponding archived SystemErrorActivityModel record.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Once an active error is resolved, it is archived to the SystemErrorActivityModel. The displayed activity includes the error description and resolution.

steps.title: Inspect the archived error fields
steps.purpose: Verify that the archived record contains the error description, recorded resolution, and timing information needed for diagnostic confirmation.
steps.instruction: On the matching SystemErrorActivityModel row in WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), inspect SystemErrorDescription, SystemErrorResolution, Start Time, Finish Time, and duration.
steps.expected_result: The matching row displays values for SystemErrorDescription, SystemErrorResolution, Start Time, Finish Time, and duration.
steps.healthy_condition: The archived row contains the expected description and resolution details, with populated Start Time, Finish Time, and duration fields.
steps.failure_condition: One or more expected fields are empty, especially Finish Time or duration.

actions.label: Inspect archived fields
actions.exact_action: Check the SystemErrorDescription, SystemErrorResolution, Start Time, Finish Time, and duration values for the record.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if Finish Time or duration is empty.
Do not treat a populated SystemErrorResolution alone as proof that the error was resolved.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Archived records display SystemErrorDescription, SystemErrorResolution, Start Time, Finish Time, and duration values.

steps.title: Confirm completed archived timing
steps.purpose: Confirm that the resolved error is represented as completed archived activity rather than only as an active-state record.
steps.instruction: In the SystemErrorActivityModel on WCS / Helix DB (SSMS), verify that the matching resolved error has both a Finish Time and a recorded duration in addition to its Start Time.
steps.expected_result: The resolved error has a populated Finish Time and duration in the SystemErrorActivityModel.
steps.healthy_condition: The archived record contains Start Time, Finish Time, and duration, along with the SystemErrorDescription and SystemErrorResolution.
steps.failure_condition: The record is absent, remains represented only as active-state information, or has an empty Finish Time or duration.

actions.label: Confirm archived completion
actions.exact_action: Confirm that the resolved error has a Finish Time and duration rather than only an active-state record.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate when an error reported as resolved has no archived SystemErrorActivityModel record.
Escalate when the archived record lacks Finish Time or duration evidence.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Once an active error is resolved, it is archived to the SystemErrorActivityModel table; the example includes Start Time, Finish Time, and duration.

success_criteria: A corresponding archived row is present in the Robotics Database SystemErrorActivityModel.
The row contains SystemErrorDescription and SystemErrorResolution.
The row contains Start Time, Finish Time, and a recorded duration.
Resolution is not accepted based only on the presence of SystemErrorResolution.
healthy_conditions: The resolved error is present as archived activity in the SystemErrorActivityModel.
SystemErrorDescription, SystemErrorResolution, Start Time, Finish Time, and duration are populated for the matching row.
failure_conditions: No corresponding archived SystemErrorActivityModel record is present.
Finish Time or duration is empty.
The record contains a SystemErrorResolution value but lacks completed timing evidence.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to L3 support when an error reported as resolved has no archived SystemErrorActivityModel record.
Escalate to L3 support when the archived record lacks Finish Time or duration evidence.
Do not infer resolution success solely from a documented SystemErrorResolution value.
